values.note: 2026 price list: electric (15/30-amp) sites $37, electric and water $42 a night plus tax, for 4 people (extra guests $8 a night, 6 max; extra tent $10). Rustic wooded sites, which the campground page offers for tents, are $30. Weekly stays 10% off. A deposit holds a reservation (20% forfeited on 30+ days' notice, all of it on shorter notice).

note: Resort on Fletcher Pond (Fletcher Floodwaters, 9,000 acres) at 20836 Tennis Rd, Hillman, running since 1938: lodge rooms, lakefront cabins and a campground of electric and water/electric sites in angled rows above the marina, plus rustic wooded sites; boat rentals, docks, shore fishing, bar and seasonal restaurant. Not on RV Life; Google 4.5 over 361 reviews. --Claude
